name: Restatement
description: Records a restatement of a previously submitted COREP return. Contains the corrected figures, root cause analysis, and remediation plan. A restatement triggers a new submission cycle (correction, validation, CFO sign-off, PRA submission) and requires proactive PRA notification.

fields.name: original_return_id
fields.description: Reference to the original submitted COREPReturn being restated

fields.name: restated_return_id
fields.description: Reference to the new corrected COREPReturn

fields.name: error_identified_date
fields.description: Date the material error was identified

fields.name: affected_templates
fields.description: COREP template codes affected by the error (e.g., CA1, CR_SA)

fields.name: root_cause_analysis
fields.description: Root cause analysis documenting how the error occurred

fields.name: remediation_plan
fields.description: Plan to prevent recurrence of the error

fields.name: pra_notified_date
fields.description: Date the PRA was proactively notified of the error
fields.validation: Required. Must be within 2 working days of error_identified_date.

relationships.description: A Restatement references both the original return and the corrected return

design_decisions.decision: Restatement is a separate entity rather than a status on COREPReturn
design_decisions.rationale: A restatement involves its own lifecycle (investigation, correction, re-validation, re-submission), root cause analysis, remediation plan, and PRA notification — sufficient complexity to warrant an independent entity. The original return and restated return are both COREPReturn instances linked through the Restatement entity.
